resources.string: Plugged in, the car can wait and only charge within a time window — at night, for example. You set it here; the car keeps the timer and follows it on its own, also when no phone is near.
Now: no timer — the car charges as soon as it\'s plugged in.
Now: the timer is paused (“Charge now”). It comes back when the car is switched on, or with “Back to the charge timer”.
Setting the charge timer works on 2014–2017 cars for now.
Reading the timer from the car…
Not set. Pick the times, then the days to use it on.
Over midnight: charges from the evening until the next morning.
On these days the car carries on charging after the window has ended until the battery is full. Plugging in after the window has ended doesn\'t start charging.
“Charge now” on the home screen skips the timer once; the timer comes back by itself the next time the car is switched on.
Charge timer saved in the car
Charge only at night or at set times
The car\'s own charge timer decides when it charges after you plug in. It\'s separate from the departures, which warm or cool the car.
The car didn\'t confirm the new charge timer — refresh and check it.
The bridge doesn\'t know this yet — update it under Settings → Updates.
